Provides the ApiError type used in P1.F2.H2 to distinguish API errors from other errors.

observations.behavior: Adds a submitEditingKeyFailure action and stale error clearing. P1.F2.H2 adds a submitEditingKeyFailure action that checks if the error is an ApiError. If it is, it either sets a field-specific error or shows a toast. P1.F2.H2 also clears stale errors before resubmitting.
